name: com.atthree.environment
description: One-click scene environments for Unity 6: sun, skybox, ambient light, fog, sky reflections and URP post-processing from presets (Day, Sunset, Night, Dungeon, Foggy), smooth runtime transitions and a day/night cycle.

samples.description: A self-building scene: switch presets with buttons, day/night cycle with a time slider, torches that light up in the dark.
